decision: PHASE 09P BIR DOCUMENT COMPLIANCE TRANSMITTAL SCAFFOLD PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
objective: Provide a design-only, non-runtime-active scaffold structuring BIR document submission responses (LOA checklists, notices for presentation/submission, additional document requests, pre-subpoena/subpoena document organization, NOD/DOD/PAN/FAN/FLD/reinvestigation/FDDA supporting documents, termination supporting documents) into a controlled document compliance and transmittal plan. This scaffold creates a structured compliance/transmittal plan only; it does not decide legal validity and does not draft final submissions.
